reading.body:
Stack Infrastructure - POR03 in Hillsboro, Oregon, is operated by Stack Infrastructure, but no IT capacity in megawatts has been published for this facility.

Without a published capacity figure, the facility cannot be sized against other data centers in this collection, or judged for whether it could plausibly host AI training infrastructure, which typically requires tens of megawatts and up. What is on record is the facility's location and operator, not its scale.

No compliance certifications are published for Stack Infrastructure - POR03. That does not mean none exist, only that this site's dataset, built from the operator's own facility page, does not list any, which limits what regulated workloads a reader could confirm the facility is qualified to host.

Oregon has 15 facilities mapped in this site's dataset, of which 8 publish a megawatt figure, totaling 192.6 MW.
